project_name: Plan an independent study project for
description: Plan an independent study project for a graduate student comparing LLM-assisted project planning against manual planning using benchmark scenarios and a final research paper.
summary: A medium complexity independent study plan in the academic domain.

phases.name: Research Framing
phases.objective: Define the research question, scope, and expected deliverables.

tasks.title: Refine research question
tasks.description: Turn the topic into a focused research question.
acceptance_criteria: Refine research question is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Define methodology
tasks.description: Choose research method, data needs, and evaluation approach.
acceptance_criteria: Define methodology is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Literature and Data Planning
phases.objective: Review prior work and prepare the evidence collection plan.

tasks.title: Conduct literature review
tasks.description: Summarize relevant sources and identify gaps.
acceptance_criteria: Conduct literature review is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Plan data collection
tasks.description: Define participants, datasets, instruments, and ethics needs.
acceptance_criteria: Plan data collection is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Analysis and Delivery
phases.objective: Analyze findings and produce final academic outputs.

tasks.title: Analyze evidence
tasks.description: Apply the selected method and document results.
acceptance_criteria: Analyze evidence is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Write final deliverable
acceptance_criteria: Write final deliverable is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

milestones.name: Research Framing Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Research Framing are complete and reviewed.

milestones.name: Literature and Data Planning Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Literature and Data Planning are complete and reviewed.

milestones.name: Analysis and Delivery Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Analysis and Delivery are complete and reviewed.

dependencies.description: T2 depends on completion of T1.
T3 depends on completion of T1.
T4 depends on completion of T2.
T5 depends on completion of T3.
T5 depends on completion of T4.
T6 depends on completion of T5.

risks.description: Project scope may expand beyond the initial plan.
risks.mitigation: Maintain an explicit MVP scope and review changes before adding work.

risks.description: Missing stakeholder input may lead to rework.
risks.mitigation: Confirm requirements and acceptance criteria before implementation.

recommendations.rationale: The Phase 1 engine uses limited input and deterministic rules.

recommendations.recommendation: Use milestones as decision gates before expanding scope.
recommendations.rationale: Decision gates reduce rework and keep dependencies visible.

assumptions: No AI provider was used; this is a deterministic Phase 1 mock plan.
Timeline was not specified and should be confirmed.
